threads.body: In `sendRequest`, the failure path does `throw (Exception) value.failed().get();`. `Try.failed().get()` returns a `Throwable`, and this cast can throw `ClassCastException` (e.g., if the failure is an `Error` or other non-`Exception` `Throwable`). Prefer `Await.result(request.execute(), ...)` (like the existing Play WS Scala client tests) so failures propagate naturally, or rethrow with a safe conversion (e.g., if it's an `Exception` throw it, otherwise wrap it).
